milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The yellow banner is placed at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7) inside the oak hut. The player must navigate within 16 blocks of the banner and face toward it (within 60° tolerance), modeling that the player has visually located the banner. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it correctly captures both proximity and visual observation.
